verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; cost per lead is being corrected now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 31 leads at an average cost of $42.40 per lead on $1,314.26 in total ad spend. The past 7 days, however, showed a 50% drop in leads alongside a 37% rise in cost per lead — the last three days of October produced just one lead on $84 in spend, which confirms this is a real efficiency problem, not a fluctuation. The pullback in Google Ads spend, particularly on your top heating campaign, reduced high-intent search volume at exactly the moment heating season demand is rising. Ad spend levels and campaign targeting are being adjusted this week to recover lead flow. Your Google Business Profile saw a 237% surge in engagement week-over-week, and your CRM pipeline remains strong with 88 jobs won this period, so underlying demand is there to be captured.
